verdict.rationale: The docs name Docker Compose as the recommended, simple install method, with npm and Helm alternatives, and describe LibreChat as a self-hosted web app (docs-35). A hands-on community user reports the install was 'quite easy' and worked well. missing for 10: the evidence shows no literal single command, gives no time-to-first-chat figure, and does not cover what minimal configuration (.env or provider keys) is needed before chatting.
